pr.title: Qualify R000C weather measurement admission
pr.body:
R000C already rejects malformed weather measurements, but its remaining native-consumer, mutation, visual-preservation and documentation obligations were not qualified. This change documents unavailable versus real zero values and publishes the original acceptance matrix, actual Chromium/Firefox evidence and independent scoped qualification. All 135 runtime files are byte-identical to base `7827099dff3c9bc5ecb1b7a67dc4c25414bcfb69`; no product repair or build was needed.

Related: #12. This Draft PR does not close the issue. Merge requires the owner's approval of the exact reviewed head and base.

- [Qualification packet](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/tree/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C) and [original acceptance matrix](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/acceptance-matrix.json).
- [Independent final local review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/independent-review/final-candidate-review.md): C01-C17 and C18's local qualification PASS in the original scopes. Independent public-head readback also PASS at this exact head/base; its full report is reproduced below.
- Four actual independent source mutations are killed by their unchanged original assertions; five positive controls survive each. Original suites retain 119 passes/four inherited TODOs, 21 authored hotfix passes and 97 related passes.
- Six controlled CURRENT-weather ingress cases per engine cover null, absent, zero and healthy temperature plus invalid, zero and healthy precipitation. Native JSON consumption, admission/cache, header and quantity-gated effects were inspected.
- C16 includes new night recovery, complete predeclared default/full motion intervals, affected reduced state/held behavior and exact-source retained policy/SIM/Moon controls. Every failed declared watch remains FAIL. No clean 30-second reduced watch, universal Firefox recording repair or startup guarantee is claimed; the [scope reconciliation](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/independent-review/c16-reduced-scope-audit.md) explains the original requirement.
- The lossless projection retains all 15 acquisitions, 30 native videos and six fixture versions, including aborts and diagnostics. Its 7,512 files contain 339,162,620 bytes excluding the manifest; all 7,509 mapped originals round-trip exactly. Large JSON is losslessly XZ-compressed. Original local execution paths remain disclosed in receipts; private owner instructions are excluded.
- Frozen V1, staged whitespace, exact Git blob identities, manifest membership and source/runtime identity checks pass. Changes comprise 11 documentation/fixture/tool/attribute files plus the evidence packet; no dependency, provider, configuration, preset or installer change.

Manifest SHA256: `849c0909d2cca582497920769524cf6c62b3baa8050d95aa4584ebe8b18f2469`.
Runtime aggregate SHA256: `5003d304bd0dba119fbc74773cd8e9a97113948259203d8c5390c9062fcc7514`.

After exact-head approval, delivery still requires marking ready and merging, GitHub Pages/served-source verification, actual public consumer readback, publication and independent readback of CLOSE-R000C, completed closure of #12 and independent closed-state verification.

<details>
<summary>Independent exact-head public readback: PASS</summary>

# Independent public-head readback — R000C / PR #60

**PASS for the exact published candidate.** [PR #60](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/pull/60) was independently read from GitHub between 2026-10-14T14:55:18.855630+00:00 and 2026-10-14T14:55:39.035054+00:00. It is open, draft and unmerged, with `mergeable: true` and `mergeable_state: clean`. Auto-merge is disabled. Its body uses `Related: #12`, contains no closing directive and explicitly keeps issue closure separate. Issue #12 remains open.

- Reviewed head: [`9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01`](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/commit/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01).
- Reviewed base and live `main`: [`7827099dff3c9bc5ecb1b7a67dc4c25414bcfb69`](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/commit/7827099dff3c9bc5ecb1b7a67dc4c25414bcfb69).
- Published commit tree: `6ff810cd8337cf7cf80c5c6511320ebacc8ea103`; the sole parent is the reviewed base.
- Manifest SHA256: `849c0909d2cca582497920769524cf6c62b3baa8050d95aa4584ebe8b18f2469`.
- Archive-map SHA256: `0023a1fc87d96d20935eb7a7b48032483b426050ba10980cadb4da18ffde3781`.

The PR head, branch ref, pull-request ref and live main ref agree and remained stable across the readback. The commit tree equals the exact independently reviewed staged tree. The complete evidence subtree was acquired through Git's tree API with `truncated: false`; all 7,512 artifact file identities and all eleven other changed file identities match the reviewed candidate. This verifies all 7,523 changes without relying on the capped PR-files listing. All 135 runtime files have the same remote Git object identities at head and base; runtime aggregate SHA256 remains `5003d304bd0dba119fbc74773cd8e9a97113948259203d8c5390c9062fcc7514`.

Public unauthenticated raw requests independently returned exact expected bytes for 32 artifacts (13,291,977 bytes): [manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/manifest.json), [lossless archive map](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/archive-map.json), original matrix/specification, candidate certificate, independent reviews, fixture and documentation, authored/generated consumer source, representative native receipts, three complete original videos, native crops, the retained reduced-watch blank frame and its complete compressed index. Stored and decompressed hashes reconcile. Whole remote-tree identity binds the remaining published originals; no native test or pixel qualification was replayed.

The published [final local review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/independent-review/final-candidate-review.md) qualifies C01–C17 and C18's local review in the original scopes. The [C16 scope correction](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9ae80bc6e729325320002d46d324a0b4aafc8f01/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000C/independent-review/c16-reduced-scope-audit.md) remains explicit. Every failed declared watch is still failed, including the reduced 107.40-second blank; the public readback gives no new continuity credit. Original local execution paths remain disclosed in archived receipts, while private owner instructions remain excluded from the hash-bound projection.

**Pending:** owner approval for this exact head/base merge, marking ready and merging after approval, Pages/served-source verification, actual public consumer readback, final `CLOSE-R000C` publication and independent readback, and completed issue closure with independent closed-state verification. The observed mergeability is a point-in-time GitHub state. This PASS supplies the public-head qualification for the owner gate; it is not merge authority, deployment proof or a completed RLGWO.
